Vendora Developers
Developer API · v2

Build with the Vendora Vendor Network

Search thousands of pre-vetted, licensed and insured service vendors by location. Pass any address fragment + a radius and get ranked results instantly.

Address-aware search

Pass any address fragment — street, city, zip, or partial — and a radius in miles. We geocode it and return vendors sorted by proximity.

Pre-vetted vendors

Every vendor in the network is scored A–F based on licensing, insurance, BBB rating, reviews, and years in business.

Simple REST API

One endpoint, standard JSON, bearer token auth. Works with any language. Get results in under 500ms.

Quick example

Request

POST /v3/vendors/search Content-Type: application/json Authorization: Bearer vnd_your_key { "description": "kitchen faucet dripping", "address": "123 Main St Newark NJ", "radius": 25, "limit": 5 }

Response

{ "total": 42, "matched_category": "PLB.GEN", "category_label": "General Plumbing", "region": { "lat": 40.7357, "lng": -74.1724, "radius_miles": 25 }, "vendors": [{ "canonical_name": "Joe's Plumbing", "score_tier": "A", "distance_miles": 3.2, "is_licensed": true, "primary_phone": "+19735551234" }] }

API Reference

Vendora v3 — find and contact local vendors from any application.

Authentication POST /v3/vendors/search Response Schema Vendor Object Request Quotes Score Tiers Code Examples Errors

Base URL

http://45.77.79.14

All endpoints are under /v3/. All requests and responses use JSON.

Authentication

Every request must include your API key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

Authorization: Bearer vnd_your_api_key_here

Create and manage your keys in the API Keys tab. Each key is shown only once at creation — store it securely.

POST /v3/vendors/search Find vendors & optionally request quotes

The core endpoint. Describe the job in plain English — Vendora automatically detects the trade category using AI, geocodes the address, and returns matching vendors sorted by distance. Set get_quotes: true to also have Vendora call or email the vendors on your behalf.

Request Body (JSON)

Field Type Required Default Description
description string Yes — Plain-English description of the job. AI classifies the trade category from this text. The more detail, the better the match. e.g. "basement light does not turn on"
address string Yes — Full property address, geocoded to find vendors nearby. City + state or full street address both work. e.g. "123 Main St Newark NJ 07102"
radius number No 25 Search radius in miles. Range: 1–200.
limit number No 20 Maximum vendors to return. Range: 1–50.
sort_by string No "distance" Sort order: distance · vendor_score · rating · review_count
get_quotes boolean No false When true, Vendora contacts vendors (phone calls + emails) and returns quote results. See Request Quotes.
vendor_ids string[] No null Used with get_quotes: true. Contact only these specific vendor IDs instead of the top search results. Max 10.
urgency string No "normal" Passed to vendors in the call script: normal · urgent · scheduled
max_vendors_to_call number No 3 When get_quotes: true and no vendor_ids, how many top vendors to contact. Range: 1–20.
requester_name string No null Name of the property manager or requester, used in the vendor call script.

Response — Search Mode (get_quotes: false)

{ "total": 47, // total vendors matched in radius "vendors": [ /* vendor objects — see below */ ], "matched_category": "PLB.GEN", // AI-detected category code "category_label": "General Plumbing", "region": { "address": "123 Main St Newark NJ", "lat": 40.7357, "lng": -74.1724, "radius_miles": 25 } }

Vendor Object

{ "vendor_id": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6", "canonical_name": "Joe's Plumbing LLC", "primary_category_code": "PLB.GEN", "category_display_name": "General Plumbing", "score_tier": "A", // A/B/C/D/F or null "vendor_score": 84.5, // 0–100 composite score "is_licensed": true, "is_insured": true, "is_onboarded": false, // onboarded = registered Vendora partner "primary_phone": "+19735551234", // E.164 format, or null "website_url": "https://joesplumbing.com", "city": "Newark", "state": "NJ", "zip": "07102", "distance_miles": 3.2, // null if address could not be geocoded "avg_rating": 4.7, // 1–5, or null "total_review_count": 52, "years_in_business": 12 // or null }
POST /v3/vendors/search with get_quotes: true

When get_quotes: true, Vendora contacts vendors automatically after finding them. Non-onboarded vendors receive an AI phone call (via VAPI). Onboarded partners receive a bid request email. A 24-hour cooldown per vendor prevents duplicate contacts — use vendor_ids to target specific vendors and bypass the search filter.

Response — Quotes Mode

{ "quote_request_id": "uuid", // tracks this quote batch "vendors_called": 3, "vendors_emailed": 1, "quotes_requested": true, "quote_results": [ { "vendor_id": "uuid", "name": "Joe's Plumbing LLC", "status": "initiated", // see statuses below "type": "vapi_call", // "vapi_call" | "bid_email" "phone": "+19735551234", "city": "Newark" } ], // ... plus all search fields (total, vendors, matched_category, region) }

Quote Result Statuses

Status Meaning
initiatedAI call or bid email successfully dispatched
bid_request_sentBid request email sent to onboarded partner vendor
cooldownVendor was contacted within the last 24 hours — skipped
no_phoneVendor has no phone number on record — skipped
errorContact attempt failed (see error field for detail)

AI Category Detection

Vendora uses an LLM to classify the job category from the description field. You do not need to pick a category — just describe the problem naturally.

PLB.GEN — General Plumbing PLB.DRN — Drain & Rooter PLB.WHR — Water Heater PLB.EMR — Emergency Plumbing ELC.GEN — General Electrical ELC.LTG — Lighting ELC.PNL — Panel / Breaker HVA.AC — Air Conditioning HVA.HTG — Heating / Furnace APP.GEN — Appliance Repair CPT.GEN — Carpentry / Drywall LCK.GEN — Locksmith ROF.GEN — Roofing PNT.GEN — Painting FLR.GEN — Flooring GEN.HDY — General Handyman

Full category list is available on request. Unrecognized descriptions fall back to GEN.HDY.

Vendor Score & Tiers

Each vendor receives a composite Vendora Score (0–100) based on licensing status, insurance, BBB accreditation, years in business, and customer reviews. The score maps to a letter tier.

A · 80–100Excellent — licensed, insured, high reviews, long track record
B · 65–79Good — meets most quality criteria
C · 50–64Average — some gaps in credentials or reviews
D · 35–49Below average — limited verifiable information
F · 0–34Poor — not recommended

Code Examples

Search vendors

curl -X POST http://45.77.79.14/v3/vendors/search -H "Authorization: Bearer vnd_your_api_key_here" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{ "description": "kitchen faucet is dripping constantly", "address": "123 Main St Newark NJ 07102", "radius": 25, "limit": 10 }'

Search + request quotes from 3 vendors

curl -X POST http://45.77.79.14/v3/vendors/search -H "Authorization: Bearer vnd_your_api_key_here" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{ "description": "kitchen faucet is dripping constantly", "address": "123 Main St Newark NJ 07102", "get_quotes": true, "max_vendors_to_call": 3 }'

Search vendors

const res = await fetch('http://45.77.79.14/v3/vendors/search', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer vnd_your_api_key_here', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', }, body: JSON.stringify({ description: 'kitchen faucet is dripping constantly', address: '123 Main St Newark NJ 07102', radius: 25, limit: 10, }), }); const { vendors, total, matched_category, category_label } = await res.json(); console.log(`${total} ${category_label} vendors found`); vendors.forEach(v => console.log(v.canonical_name, v.distance_miles + ' mi'));

Request quotes from specific vendors

const res = await fetch('http://45.77.79.14/v3/vendors/search', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer vnd_your_api_key_here', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', }, body: JSON.stringify({ description: 'kitchen faucet is dripping constantly', address: '123 Main St Newark NJ 07102', get_quotes: true, vendor_ids: ['uuid-1', 'uuid-2', 'uuid-3'], urgency: 'normal', }), }); const { vendors_called, vendors_emailed, quote_results } = await res.json(); console.log(`Called: ${vendors_called}, Emailed: ${vendors_emailed}`);

Search vendors

import requests VENDORA_KEY = "vnd_your_api_key_here" HEADERS = { "Authorization": f"Bearer {VENDORA_KEY}", "Content-Type": "application/json", } resp = requests.post( "http://45.77.79.14/v3/vendors/search", json={ "description": "kitchen faucet is dripping constantly", "address": "123 Main St Newark NJ 07102", "radius": 25, "limit": 10, }, headers=HEADERS, ) data = resp.json() print(f"Found {data['total']} {data['category_label']} vendors") for v in data["vendors"]: print(f" {v['canonical_name']} — {v['distance_miles']} mi ({v['score_tier']})")

Request quotes

resp = requests.post( "http://45.77.79.14/v3/vendors/search", json={ "description": "kitchen faucet is dripping constantly", "address": "123 Main St Newark NJ 07102", "get_quotes": True, "vendor_ids": ["uuid-1", "uuid-2"], }, headers=HEADERS, ) data = resp.json() print(f"Called: {data['vendors_called']}, Emailed: {data['vendors_emailed']}") for r in data["quote_results"]: print(f" {r['name']} → {r['status']}")

HTTP Status Codes

Code Meaning Common Cause
200 OK Request succeeded
400 Bad Request Missing required field (description or address), or invalid parameter value
401 Unauthorized Missing, invalid, or revoked API key
500 Server Error Unexpected error — the response body contains an error field with details
// Error response shape { "error": "description is required" }

Limits

• 5 API keys per developer account

• 50 vendors max returned per request

• 200 miles max search radius

• 10 vendor IDs max in vendor_ids

• 24-hour cooldown per vendor — prevents duplicate quote requests

• Please keep requests under 10 per second. Rate limiting will be enforced in a future release.
